business_process: Emergency alarm call-out and HSE reporting
description: SCADA alarm call-out of H2S, tank high-level, and shutdown events to on-call staff; spill and release reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Local hardwired shutdowns and beacons still work without SCADA, but nobody is told remotely; an unreported discharge that reaches water must be reported to the National Response Center immediately (40 CFR 110.6); H2S exposure risk to staff and neighbors
manual_workaround: Roving patrols of all Panhandle sour-gas sites every 2 hours; Production Controllers phone field crews; spill reports by phone from the HSE on-call binder
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Controllers; Field Superintendents; HSE on-call; OCC

description: Water injection plant and saltwater disposal wells take about 55,000 barrels of produced water per day; SCADA monitors pressures and rates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Water storage at the tank batteries and plant fills in about 8 hours at full rate; after that producing wells must be shut in; injection pressure limits are a permit condition
manual_workaround: Plant operators run the injection plant locally from the plant PLC panel; shut in highest-water-cut wells first to buy time
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02 (plant PLCs; SWD RTUs); SYS-08

description: 24x7 OCC monitoring of 118 wells and 8 facilities; remote start and stop of wells; pump-off control and ESP drive settings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without SCADA every site must be visited by truck; staff can cover the Panhandle for about a day, and the 34 cellular-only South Florida sites are shut in after 24 hours; lost production about $104K per day if all wells stop
manual_workaround: Manual operations: lease operators visit each pad on a route, gauge tanks by hand, and shut in wells they cannot cover; field superintendents set the shut-in order
dependent_third_parties: SCADA integrator; cellular carrier; radio tower lease
dependent_people_or_facilities: Production Controllers; lease operators; automation technicians

business_process: Crude oil custody transfer and hauling
description: Tank gauging, run tickets, and loading of purchaser trucks at 5 tank batteries; run tickets entered in the field data capture app
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tank storage holds about 3 days of production; if trucks cannot load, wells are shut in; run tickets are the basis for sales and royalties
manual_workaround: Paper run tickets signed by the gauger and the truck driver; manual tank strapping tables in the tank battery binders
dependent_systems: SYS-04 (field data capture app); SYS-09 (tablets); SYS-03
dependent_third_parties: Crude purchaser and its trucking carrier

description: Two compression stations deliver associated gas to the third-party gathering system through the lease sales meter
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Station PLCs run locally; without compression, wells making associated gas must be curtailed within about a day
manual_workaround: Station operators run compressors from local panels; curtail high gas-oil-ratio wells
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02 (station PLCs; electronic flow meters)

description: Daily volume allocation, monthly close, state production reports, monthly royalty payments to about 2,300 owners, and joint interest billing to 9 partners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Royalty payments go out monthly and owners notice late payments; month-end close and state production reports have fixed due dates; allocations can be rebuilt from run tickets and meter data
manual_workaround: Rebuild daily volumes from paper run tickets and meter printouts; delay the royalty run and notify owners

description: Work orders, rig and crew scheduling, parts; predictive maintenance alerts (pilot)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A failed pump stays down until a rig is dispatched; a 3-day backlog is manageable with the whiteboard schedule
manual_workaround: Whiteboard rig schedule at each field office; paper work orders; phone dispatch

description: Biweekly payroll for 250 employees; time capture from field crews; onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; paper time sheets

business_process: Finance, payables, and crude sales settlement
description: Accounts payable, purchaser sales statements, bank reconciliations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Purchasers pay monthly; vendors tolerate a short delay
manual_workaround: Manual checks for urgent payables; purchaser statements by email

description: Seismic interpretation, reservoir models, and waterflood surveillance for drilling and injection decisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No daily operation depends on it; the risk is confidentiality (trade secret), not downtime
manual_workaround: Defer analysis; work from local copies
